_comment: Only the TYPES.* keys do anything: Foundry uses them to name document types (create dialog, default titles). The rest of the interface is hardcoded pt-BR in the templates/JS — the system does not call game.i18n. The NIHILITY.* keys that used to live here were never read by anything and were removed so this file stops promising a translation that does not happen. Actually translating the system would require an internationalization pass, not just filling in this file.
TYPES.Item.title: Title
